name: Zoom Clinical Notes

short_description: Zoom's AI scribe in Zoom Workplace for Clinicians: drafts notes from in-person, video and phone visits, suggests ICD-10 codes. BAA available; sold by quote.
long_description: Zoom Clinical Notes is the AI scribe in Zoom Workplace for Clinicians. It captures in-person visits and visits held over Zoom Meetings, Zoom Phone or Zoom Contact Center, and drafts a clinical note that Zoom says arrives in 60 seconds or less. Zoom lists customizable templates for over 100 medical specialties, ICD-10 code suggestions from the visit transcript and support for 10 languages, including English and Spanish. Notes reach the EHR through open APIs or a Chrome and Edge extension, and Zoom markets Epic Haiku and Hyperspace integrations. Zoom states it signs a Business Associate Agreement for healthcare customers and does not use customer data to train its or third-party AI models. Pricing is not published; Zoom sells it through sales and demos. It is a general medical scribe rather than a therapy-specific one, so it fits organizations already running telehealth on Zoom more than a solo therapist shopping for a scribe.
one_liner: AI visit notes built into Zoom for clinicians, for in-person, video and phone visits.
best_for: Group practices and health systems that already run telehealth on Zoom for Healthcare
Organizations whose clinicians see patients in person, by video and by phone

Epic customers interested in Zoom's Haiku and Hyperspace integrations
not_for: Solo therapists who want published pricing and self-serve sign-up
Clinicians who want therapy-specific note formats and treatment plans out of the box
Practices that do not use Zoom for video visits

faqs.a: It is the AI scribe in Zoom Workplace for Clinicians. It captures in-person, Zoom video and Zoom Phone visits and drafts a clinical note, with ICD-10 code suggestions.

faqs.q: Does Zoom sign a BAA for Clinical Notes?
faqs.a: Zoom states it executes a Business Associate Agreement with healthcare customers and that, with a BAA in place, it enables HIPAA compliance. BAAs are arranged through Zoom sales.

faqs.q: How much does Zoom Clinical Notes cost?
faqs.a: Zoom does not publish a price for Zoom Workplace for Clinicians or Clinical Notes. Buyers request a demo and quote from Zoom sales.

faqs.q: How do Zoom clinical notes get into my EHR?
faqs.a: Through open APIs or a Chrome and Edge browser extension, depending on setup. Zoom also markets Epic Haiku and Hyperspace integrations.
